commitResults.messageTitle: UserPrefs: add persisted command alias registry
commitResults.messageBody:
User preferences do not store command aliases, so aliases are lost
between sessions.

Persisting the alias registry keeps user-defined shortcuts available
after restart and provides a single source for alias lookup.

commitResults.messageTitle: Alias prefs tests: cover persistence and model state
commitResults.messageBody:
Alias persistence is now part of user preferences, but tests do not
validate model interactions and JSON round trips thoroughly.

Add focused tests for alias registry mutation and persistence so future
changes do not break saved alias state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Logic: expand leading command aliases before parsing
commitResults.messageBody:
Logic parsing currently ignores saved aliases when resolving user input.

Expand only the leading command word before parsing and save
preferences after successful execution so alias behavior stays
predictable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Logic tests: cover alias expansion and prefs saves
commitResults.messageBody:
Alias expansion and preference saving are implemented, but logic-level
tests cover only part of the behavior.

Add tests for command-only and command-with-arguments expansion and
verify successful commands persist aliases to storage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Alias commands: support create list and remove
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need command aliases, but the parser currently supports only core
commands.

Add alias, aliases, and unalias commands with validation that rejects
invalid targets and keeps expansion single-pass to avoid cycles.

commitResults.messageTitle: Alias tests: cover conflicts expansion and persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
Core alias commands are in place, but test coverage is missing for
conflict handling and end-to-end command behavior.

Add parser and logic tests for creating, using, listing, and removing
aliases, including reserved names and invalid targets.

Alias commands were added, but the User Guide does not explain how to
use or persist them.

Document alias creation, listing, and removal, and clarify that aliases
are saved in preferences.

commitResults.messageTitle: Logic: add edit-prev command recall support
commitResults.messageBody: Keep command history session-only in LogicManager, add an editprev command word alongside rerun, and return recalled command text through CommandResult so CommandBox can repopulate the input field without executing it.

commitResults.messageTitle: Logic tests: cover editprev command recall
commitResults.messageBody: Add coverage for editprev success, missing-history, argument validation, and its interaction with rerun. Extend CommandResult tests to cover the optional command-box populate text used by the UI.

commitResults.messageTitle: EditCommand: support role and notes field updates
commitResults.messageBody:
Edit already supports tags, volunteer availability, and volunteer records,
but it cannot update role or notes.

This forces users to recreate a volunteer when only those two fields need
correction.

Let's extend the existing parser and descriptor flow so edit can update
role and notes while preserving duplicate checks and tag replacement
semantics.

commitResults.messageTitle: Edit tests: cover role notes and invalid empty edits
commitResults.messageBody:
Role and notes are new edit inputs, and empty edit descriptors are now
rejected before command execution.

Add parser, descriptor, and command coverage for role and notes updates,
tag clearing, and empty edit rejection so the new edit flow stays
protected.

Docs: clarify volunteer edit availability fields

commitResults.messageTitle: Edit tests: expand volunteer field coverage
commitResults.messageBody:
Volunteer-specific edit fields include role, notes, availability, and
records, but the tests only covered part of that behavior.

Add execution coverage for replacing and clearing those fields, extend
descriptor equality coverage to availability and record collections, and
verify parser failures for invalid availability and record inputs.

Isolate createPredicate into its own factory
edit UML diagrams to match new architecture
Find parser: use static predicate factory
commitResults.messageBody:
FindMatchTypeFactory can still be instantiated even though it only
provides factory behavior.

That weakens the intent of the abstraction and does not match the
requested utility-style factory pattern.

Let's make the factory final, add a throwing private constructor,
and call createPredicate() statically from the parser and focused
tests.

This keeps the refactor minimal while making the factory API explicit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Find docs: update predicate factory sequence
commitResults.messageBody:
The find documentation still uses the older predicate creation flow.

That makes the sequence diagram harder to read because the match type
and predicate factory responsibilities are not shown consistently.

Let's show FindMatchType as the class used for token parsing, route
predicate creation through FindMatchTypeFactory, and regenerate the
sequence diagram image. Update the DG text to use the matching static
factory method notation as well.
